t: This is Sussex Gardens, a broad avenue in Paddington, running west from the Edgware Road through the residential area of Tyburnia, north of Hyde Park. Near Lancaster Gate it turns into a garden square. The writer Cicely Hamilton was born here. She was an actress, journalist, suffragist and feminist, and she's best known for the play How the Vote Was Won, in which a man who opposes votes for women changes his mind when the women around him go on strike. She also wrote A Pageant of Great Women, which was performed often.
